worker_unit:
[Unit]
Description=Moodify Phase-I Data Factory Worker
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=moodify
Group=moodify
WorkingDirectory=/opt/moodify/moodify-core-package
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=MOODIFY_NODE_STATE_DIR=/var/lib/moodify
Environment=MOODIFY_NODE_OUTPUT_ROOT=/var/lib/moodify/data_factory
Environment=MOODIFY_NODE_POLL_SECONDS=10
Environment=MOODIFY_NODE_MIN_AVAILABLE_MB=300
Environment=MOODIFY_NODE_MIN_FREE_DISK_GB=3
ExecStart=/opt/moodify/.venv/bin/moodify-node worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
TimeoutStopSec=120
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=best-effort
IOSchedulingPriority=6
# Soft pressure signal; intentionally no hard MemoryMax until real-case evidence exists.
MemoryHigh=1500M
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/moodify

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
